name: chrome-agent-bridge
description: Control and monitor user-approved Chrome tabs through a local MCP bridge, including safe network projections and explicit Raw CDP sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Control and monitor approved Chrome tabs through MCP.
interface.longDescription: A local, open-source Chrome bridge for Agents. It provides high-level tab, page, screenshot, interaction, and sanitized network tools, plus explicit Raw Chrome DevTools Protocol commands that can share one attachment with a safe projected network stream.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my current Chrome tab and summarize the page.
Monitor requests while I perform an action in Chrome.
Use Raw CDP on the approved tab and detach when finished.
